messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
ಆ ವಿನಮ್ರ ಇಟಲಿಗೆ ಅವನು ರಕ್ಷಣೆಯಾಗುವನು ಆದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಕಮಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕನ್ಯೆ ಮರಣವಾಯಿತು, ಯೂರಿಯಾಲಸ್, ಟರ್ನಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಸಸ್ ತಮ್ಮ ಗಾಯಗಳಿಂದ.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Kannada) | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|--------------------------------|--------------------------|--------| | Di | Preposition introducing the genitive relationship “of” | ಆ | “that” (demonstrative) | OK | | quella | Demonstrative determiner “that” | ಆ | “that” | OK | | umile | Attribute “humble” | ವಿನಮ್ರ | “humble” | OK | | Italia | Proper noun “Italy” | ಇಟಲಿ | “Italy” | OK | | fia | Future copular verb “shall be” | ಆಗುವನು | “will become” | OK | | salute | Noun “salvation” (state of being saved) | ರಕ್ಷಣ | “salvation” | OK | | per | Preposition introducing the causal/resultative phrase “for which” | ಆದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ | “for that” | OK | | cui | Relative pronoun “which/that” (refers to the salvation) | — | *(none)* | **MISSING** | | morì | Simple past “died” | ಮರಣವಾಯಿತು | “died” | OK | | la | Definite article (feminine) – not required in Kannada | — | *(none)* | **UNNECESSARY** | | vergine | Noun “virgin” (title/epithet) | ಕನ್ಯೆ | “virgin” | OK | | Cammilla | Proper name “Camilla” | ಕಮಿಲ್ಲಾ | “Camilla” | OK | | Eurialo | Proper name “Euryalus” | ಯೂರಿಯಾಲಸ್ | “Euryalus” | OK | | e (1st) | Coordinating conjunction “and” | ಮತ್ತು | “and” | OK | | Turno | Proper name “Turnus” | ಟರ್ನಸ್ | “Turnus” | OK | | e (2nd) | Coordinating conjunction “and” | ಮತ್ತು | “and” | OK | | Niso | Proper name “Nisus” | ನಿಸಸ್ | “Nisus” | OK | | di | Preposition “of” (introducing the adjectival phrase) | ತಮ್ಮ | “their” (possessive) | **WRONG** (does not convey the same “of” relation) | | ferute | Past participle used adjectivally “wounded” | ಗಾಯಗಳಿಂದ | “by their wounds” | **WRONG** (expresses cause rather than the adjectival state “wounded”) |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **MISSING:** *cui* – the relative pronoun is not rendered separately in the Kannada version. - **UNNECESSARY:** *la* – Kannada does not use definite articles, so the article is naturally omitted. - **WRONG:** *di* – rendered as the possessive “ತಮ್ಮ” instead of the prepositional “of”. - **WRONG:** *ferute* – rendered as “ಗಾಯಗಳಿಂದ” (“by their wounds”) rather than the adjectival state “wounded”.
All other tokens are correctly mapped and grammatically appropriate in the target language.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 106: - Original: ಆ ವಿನಮ್ರ ಇಟಲಿಗೆ ಅವನು ರಕ್ಷಣೆಯಾಗುವನು - Issue: none - Corrected: ಆ ವಿನಮ್ರ ಇಟಲಿಗೆ ಅವನು ರಕ್ಷಣೆಯಾಗುವನು
- Line 107: - Original: ಆದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಕಮಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕನ್ಯೆ ಮರಣವಾಯಿತು, - Issue: missing relative pronoun “cui” - Corrected: ಆದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ **ಅದಕ್ಕೆ** ಕಮಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕನ್ಯೆ ಮರಣವಾಯಿತು,
- Line 108: - Original: ಯೂರಿಯಾಲಸ್, ಟರ್ನಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಸಸ್ ತಮ್ಮ ಗಾಯಗಳಿಂದ. - Issue: wrong preposition “di” and wrong rendering of “ferute” (wounded) - Corrected: ಯೂರಿಯಾಲಸ್, ಟರ್ನಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಸಸ್ **ಗಾಯಗೊಂಡರು**.
```kannada ಆ ವಿನಮ್ರ ಇಟಲಿಗೆ ಅವನು ರಕ್ಷಣೆಯಾಗುವನು ಆದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಮಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕನ್ಯೆ ಮರಣವಾಯಿತು, ಯೂರಿಯಾಲಸ್, ಟರ್ನಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಸಸ್ ಗಾಯಗೊಂಡರು. ```
